proposed_edit.new_declaration:
@[to_additive]
lemma finite_div {α} [DivisionMonoid α] [IsLeftCancelMul α] [IsRightCancelMul α] {s t : Set α} :
    (s / t).Finite ↔ s.Finite ∧ t.Finite ∨ s = ∅ ∨ t = ∅ :=
  finite_image2 (fun b _ ↦ (div_left_injective (b := b)).injOn)
    fun a _ ↦ (div_right_injective (b := a)).injOn
